title: Luminaires - Part 5: Particular Requirements - Section 3: Luminaires for Road and Street Lighting
scope: Specifies requirements for road and street lighting luminaires, for use with electrical light sources (including LED luminaires) on supply voltages not exceeding 1 000 V. Covers optical, mechanical and electrical safety requirements for outdoor road illumination.
description: Standard governing the mechanical construction, ingress protection (IP ratings), thermal management, and electrical insulation of street lighting luminaires deployed in municipal, highway, and public lighting tenders.
technicalRequirements: Minimum Ingress Protection IP65 for optical compartment and IP65/IP66 for gear compartment
Protection class Class I or Class II electrical insulation
Windage and mechanical impact resistance (IK08 minimum)
Creepage distances and clearances compliance per IS 10322 (Part 1)
Thermal endurance test at 45°C ambient maximum operating rating
amendments: Amendment No. 1 (2018) - Update to LED testing alignment
Amendment No. 2 (2021) - Marking and energy efficiency criteria

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services - Part 1: Safety Requirements
scope: Specifies the safety and interchangeability requirements, together with the test methods and conditions required to show compliance of LED lamps with integrated means for controlling, intended for domestic and similar general lighting purposes.
description: Fundamental electrical safety standard for self-ballasted LED lamps covering electric shock protection, insulation resistance, mechanical strength, fault conditions, and flame retardance.
technicalRequirements: Insulation resistance not less than 4 MΩ between live parts and accessible parts
Electric strength test at 4 000 V AC for reinforced insulation
Resistance to heat and fire glow-wire test at 650°C
Mechanical cap retention torque test conforming to standard cap designations
amendments: Amendment No. 1 (2017) - Marking requirements
Amendment No. 2 (2019) - Extended photobiological safety clauses

source.sourceName: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) / MeitY CRS

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services - Part 2: Performance Requirements
scope: Specifies performance requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps together with test methods, including lamp wattage, luminous flux, correlated color temperature (CCT), color rendering index (CRI), and lumen maintenance life.
description: Core performance testing benchmark for LED procurement ensuring efficacy (lumens per watt), chromaticity tolerance, power factor, and sustained lumen output over 25,000 to 50,000 operational hours.
technicalRequirements: Initial luminous efficacy not less than 85 lm/W for warm white and 95 lm/W for cool daylight
Minimum Color Rendering Index (CRI) Ra ≥ 80
Power factor ≥ 0.90 for ratings above 5W
Lumen maintenance ≥ 70% (L70) at 6 000 hours endurance burn-in test
amendments: Amendment No. 1 (2018) - Minimum luminous efficacy thresholds updated

title: Lamp Controlgear - Part 2: Particular Requirements - Section 13: DC or AC Supplied Electronic Controlgear for LED Modules
scope: Specifies particular safety requirements for electronic controlgear (LED drivers) for use on d.c. supplies up to 250 V and a.c. supplies up to 1 000 V at 50 Hz or 60 Hz. Covers surge protection, thermal cutoff, and output isolation.
description: Mandatory standard for LED drivers used inside outdoor street lights and indoor luminaires, ensuring electrical safety, surge immunity, and short-circuit protection under Indian grid fluctuations.
technicalRequirements: Input voltage operational range 140 V to 300 V AC, with withstand capability up to 320 V AC for 48 hours
Built-in surge protection minimum 4 kV (line-to-earth) for outdoor applications
Short-circuit and open-circuit automatic recovery protection
Total Harmonic Distortion (THD) < 10% in accordance with grid harmonics norms
amendments: Amendment No. 1 (2017) - High voltage surge protection guidelines added

title: LED Modules for General Lighting - Part 1: Safety Requirements
scope: Specifies general and safety requirements for Light Emitting Diode (LED) modules for use on constant-voltage, constant-current, or constant-power supplies.
description: Standard ensuring that the core LED light engine/board complies with insulation, creepage distances, thermal endurance, and photobiological safety standards.
technicalRequirements: Exempt group or Risk Group 1 photobiological safety per IS 16108 / IEC 62471
Thermal endurance testing at specified tc point without degradation of insulation
Moisture resistance and insulation resistance ≥ 2 MΩ
amendments: Amendment No. 1 (2019) - Photobiological labeling and tc marking

title: Specification for Industrial Safety Helmets
scope: Covers requirements regarding materials, construction, finish, and performance for helmets intended for use in mining, tunnelling, quarrying, construction, and general industrial environments to protect against falling objects and impact.
description: The benchmark Indian Standard for industrial safety helmets specifying shock absorption, penetration resistance, flammability, electrical insulation, and chin strap retention strength.
technicalRequirements: Shock absorption test: transmitted force not to exceed 5.0 kN under 5 kg drop striker from 1 m
Penetration resistance: striker shall not make contact with headform surface
Electrical insulation: leakage current not exceeding 3 mA at 1 200 V AC for electrical grade helmets
Flammability: material shall not burn with emission of flame after 5 seconds of burner removal
Water absorption less than 0.5% by weight
amendments: Amendment No. 1 (1988) - Shell rigidity parameters
Amendment No. 2 (1993) - Chin strap retention specification
Amendment No. 3 (2000) - Test headform dimensional calibration

title: Industrial Safety Belts and Harnesses - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements, sampling, and methods of test for safety belts, safety harnesses, lanyards, and lifelines for industrial personnel working at heights to prevent falls or arrest falls safely.
description: Essential standard for fall arrest systems and full body harnesses, mandating static breaking load, dynamic drop testing, corrosion resistance of hardware, and energy absorbing lanyards.
technicalRequirements: Static strength: full body harness must withstand minimum 15 kN tensile load without rupture
Dynamic performance: 100 kg test torso dropped from free-fall height without release or excessive acceleration (> 6g)
Webbing width minimum 40 mm with synthetic polyester or polyamide fiber construction
Metal D-rings and buckles proof tested to 11.5 kN and corrosion resistance test (salt spray 50 hours)
amendments: Amendment No. 1 (2002) - Full body harness dynamic test protocol
Amendment No. 2 (2017) - Energy absorber rating requirements

title: Personal Protective Equipment - Part 2: Safety Footwear
scope: Specifies basic and additional (optional) requirements for safety footwear used for general industrial purposes, including mechanical hazards, slip resistance, thermal risks, and ergonomic behavior.
description: Standard for safety boots and industrial shoes equipped with steel/composite toecaps providing impact resistance of 200 Joules and compression resistance of 15 kN.
technicalRequirements: Toecap impact resistance minimum 200 J and compression resistance 15 kN
Upper material tear strength ≥ 120 N for leather and thickness ≥ 1.8 mm
Outsole abrasion resistance (relative volume loss < 150 mm³)
Anti-slip resistance on ceramic tile with NaLS and steel floor with glycerol (SRA/SRB/SRC rating)
amendments: Amendment No. 1 (2019) - Slip resistance test method updates

title: Respiratory Protective Devices - Filtering Half Masks to Protect Against Particles - Specification
scope: Specifies minimum requirements for filtering half masks as respiratory protective devices against particulates (dusts, mists, fumes), classifying devices into FFP1, FFP2, and FFP3 classes.
description: Standard governing particulate filtering respirators for industrial workers exposed to hazardous dusts, silica, and aerosols.
technicalRequirements: Sodium chloride and paraffin oil penetration filter efficiency: FFP1 ≥ 80%, FFP2 ≥ 94%, FFP3 ≥ 99%
Total inward leakage (TIL) not exceeding 8% for FFP2 class
Breathing resistance: inhalation resistance ≤ 2.4 mbar at 95 L/min for FFP2
Flammability test: mask passed through flame at 800°C without continuing to burn
amendments: Amendment No. 1 (2014) - Clogging test options
Amendment No. 2 (2020) - Packaging and shelf-life marking

title: Polyvinyl Chloride Insulated Unsheathed and Sheathed Cables/Cords with Rigid and Flexible Conductor for Working Voltages up to and Including 450/750 V
scope: Specifies requirements and test methods for single and multi-core cables with PVC insulation and sheathing for electrical wiring in fixed installations and flexible connections.
description: The definitive standard for domestic and industrial building wiring cables, flame-retardant (FR/FRLS) wires, and power cord sets up to 1 100 V rating.
technicalRequirements: Plain annealed electrolytic copper conductor conforming to IS 8130 Class 1, 2, or 5
PVC Type A insulation with oxygen index ≥ 29% for FR grade
Conductor resistance verified per IS 8130 at 20°C reference temperature
Spark test voltage 6 kV AC for online spark testing of insulation
amendments: Amendment No. 1 (2014) - Addition of Halogen Free Flame Retardant options
Amendment No. 2 (2021) - Conductor compaction criteria

title: Electrical Accessories - Circuit-Breakers for Overcurrent Protection for Household and Similar Installations (MCBs)
scope: Applies to a.c. air-break circuit-breakers for operation at 50 Hz or 60 Hz, having a rated voltage not exceeding 440 V, a rated current not exceeding 125 A, and a rated short-circuit capacity not exceeding 25 000 A.
description: Standard for Miniature Circuit Breakers (MCBs) protecting circuits against overloads and short circuits in distribution boards for commercial, residential, and public works.
technicalRequirements: Rated breaking capacity minimum 10 000 A (10 kA) for commercial distribution boards
Tripping characteristics: Type B (3-5 In), Type C (5-10 In), and Type D (10-20 In)
Endurance test: 4 000 operating cycles with current and 6 000 cycles mechanical without current
Temperature rise test at terminal connections not exceeding 60 K at rated current
amendments: Amendment No. 1 (2014) - DC application annexure
Amendment No. 2 (2020) - Coordination with upstream backup fuses

title: Residual Current Operated Circuit-Breakers Without Integral Overcurrent Protection for Household and Similar Uses (RCCBs)
scope: Applies to residual current operated circuit-breakers functionally independent of, or functionally dependent on, line voltage, for rated voltages not exceeding 440 V a.c. and rated currents not exceeding 125 A.
description: Standard for RCCBs providing critical life-safety earth-leakage protection against direct and indirect contact electric shock and fire hazards in procurement tenders.
technicalRequirements: Rated residual operating current (IΔn) 30 mA for personnel protection, 100 mA/300 mA for fire protection
Break time not exceeding 300 ms at rated IΔn and 40 ms at 5 IΔn
Conditional short-circuit current withstand rating matched to upstream protective MCB
Test push-button functional verification under voltage variation down to 85% of rated voltage
amendments: Amendment No. 1 (2019) - Type A RCCB pulsed DC sensitivity specifications

title: Code of Practice for Earthing
scope: Provides detailed guidelines on the design, installation, calculation, inspection, and testing of earthing systems for electrical installations in domestic, commercial, and industrial facilities.
description: The principal Indian standard for earthing and grounding, specifying pipe, plate, and strip electrodes, soil resistivity measurements, fault current dissipation, and bonding methods.
technicalRequirements: Earth resistance target < 1.0 Ω for substations and generating stations, < 5.0 Ω for general commercial buildings
Electrode materials: hot-dip galvanized steel pipe (class B), cast iron plate, or copper-bonded steel rod
Minimum cross section of earth continuity conductor (GI strip 25x3 mm or copper 16 sq mm)
Equipotential bonding of all exposed extraneous conductive parts
applications: Data center and hospital electrical rooms
amendments: Amendment No. 1 (2020) - Guidelines on maintenance-free chemical earthing compounds

title: Rotomoulded Polyethylene Water Storage Tanks - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for materials, dimensions, construction, and performance of rotational moulded polyethylene cylindrical and rectangular water storage tanks for potable water storage.
description: Standard governing overhead and loft plastic water tanks (rotomoulded HDPE/LLDPE), defining wall thickness, ultraviolet stabilization for outdoor exposure, and potable water safety.
technicalRequirements: Raw material food grade virgin polyethylene meeting IS 10146 requirements for contact with drinking water
Carbon black content 2.0% to 3.0% or UV stabilizer UV-531 for outdoor sunlight protection
Minimum wall thickness graduated from top to base per nominal capacity table
Drop impact test from 1.5 m height onto flat concrete surface at 0°C without crack or rupture
applications: Rural drinking water supply schemes (Jal Jeevan Mission)
amendments: Amendment No. 1 (2002) - Thickness tolerance specifications
Amendment No. 2 (2007) - Multi-layer tank testing protocol
Amendment No. 3 (2018) - Antimicrobial layer validation

title: Unplasticized Polyvinyl Chloride (uPVC) Pipes for Potable Water Supplies - Specification
scope: Covers requirements for plain and socket-ended unplasticized polyvinyl chloride (uPVC) pipes intended for potable water supplies and agricultural distribution pipelines.
description: Primary standard for municipal and building water delivery pipes, specifying hydrostatic strength, opacity, resistance to internal pressure, and toxic substance extraction limits.
technicalRequirements: Hydrostatic pressure test: pipes withstand 4.2 times rated pressure for 1 hour at 27°C
Resistance to external blows (falling weight impact test) true relative impact rate < 10%
Opacity of pipe walls > 0.2% to prevent algae growth inside potable water mains
Maximum toxic substance extraction: Lead ≤ 1.0 mg/L first extraction and ≤ 0.05 mg/L third extraction
amendments: Amendment No. 1 (2023) - Prohibition of lead-based stabilizers in potable water pipes

title: Drinking Water - Specification
scope: Prescribes requirements and methods of sampling and test for drinking water intended for human consumption, covering organoleptic, physical, chemical, toxic, and bacteriological parameters.
description: National drinking water quality standard specifying acceptable limits and permissible limits in the absence of an alternate source for TDS, turbidity, heavy metals, pesticides, and E. coli.
technicalRequirements: Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) acceptable limit 500 mg/L, permissible limit 2 000 mg/L
Turbidity acceptable limit 1 NTU, permissible limit 5 NTU
E. coli or thermotolerant coliform bacteria shall not be detectable in any 100 mL sample
Lead maximum limit 0.01 mg/L; Arsenic maximum limit 0.01 mg/L
applications: RO drinking water plants for railway stations
amendments: Amendment No. 1 (2015) - Revision of pesticide residue tolerances
Amendment No. 2 (2018) - Microcystin and viral indicator guidance
Amendment No. 3 (2021) - Disinfection by-products limits

title: Centrifugally Cast (Spun) Iron Pressure Pipes for Water, Gas and Sewage - Specification
scope: Specifies requirements for centrifugally cast iron pressure pipes for conveying water, gas, and sewage under pressure, with socket and spigot, or flanged ends.
description: Standard for cast iron and ductile iron spun pipes utilized in heavy-duty municipal underground water transmission mains and sewage pressure pipelines.
technicalRequirements: Tensile strength not less than 420 MPa for ductile cast iron
Hydrostatic works test pressure up to 5.0 MPa depending on pipe diameter and class
Internal cement mortar lining thickness per standard nominal bore schedule
External metallic zinc coating with finishing layer of bituminous paint
amendments: Amendment No. 1 (2008) - Cement mortar lining tolerance criteria

title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete - Code of Practice
scope: Deals with the general structural use of plain and reinforced concrete in buildings, bridges, and other civil structures, covering materials, design methods, workmanship, inspection, and testing.
description: The mother code for civil engineering concrete construction in India, specifying characteristic compressive strength grades (M20 to M80), water-cement ratio, cover to reinforcement, and curing standards.
technicalRequirements: Minimum cement content 300 kg/m³ and maximum water-cement ratio 0.50 for moderate exposure RCC
28-day characteristic compressive cube strength verification per IS 516
Nominal clear cover to reinforcement: 20 mm for slabs, 25 mm for beams, 40 mm for columns
Workability slump requirements conforming to compaction factor and flow table methods
amendments: Amendment No. 1 (2001) - Aggregate alkali reactivity guidance
Amendment No. 2 (2005) - Self-compacting concrete annexure
Amendment No. 3 (2007) - Mineral admixtures usage ratio
Amendment No. 4 (2013) - Concrete grade expansion to M100
Amendment No. 5 (2019) - Durability requirements update

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement - Specification
scope: Covers the requirements of deformed steel bars and wires for use as reinforcement in concrete in grades Fe 415, Fe 415D, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550, Fe 550D, and Fe 600.
description: Standard for Thermo-Mechanically Treated (TMT) rebars for reinforced concrete structures, specifying yield strength, elongation for seismic ductility, rib geometry, and bend/rebend properties.
technicalRequirements: Grade Fe 500D: 0.2% proof stress / yield strength ≥ 500 MPa, tensile strength ≥ 565 MPa, elongation ≥ 16.0%
Ratio of tensile strength to yield stress (TS/YS) ≥ 1.10 for earthquake-resistant design
Bend and rebend test without sign of rupture or cracks around standard mandrel diameter
Maximum carbon equivalent (CE) ≤ 0.42% for superior weldability
amendments: Amendment No. 1 (2012) - Introduction of Fe 650 and Fe 700 grades
Amendment No. 2 (2017) - Mandatory rolling mark frequency on rebar surface

title: Ordinary Portland Cement, 43 Grade - Specification
scope: Covers manufacture, chemical and physical requirements of 43 grade ordinary Portland cement (OPC 43), including fineness, soundness, setting time, and compressive strength.
description: Standard for 43 Grade OPC used widely in general civil works, plastering, non-structural masonry, and moderate-strength concrete foundations.
technicalRequirements: Compressive strength: 72±1 h ≥ 23 MPa, 168±2 h ≥ 33 MPa, 672±4 h (28 days) ≥ 43 MPa and < 58 MPa
Initial setting time not less than 30 minutes; final setting time not more than 600 minutes
Soundness by Le Chatelier method not more than 10 mm; by autoclave method not more than 0.8%
Specific surface area (fineness) by Blaine air permeability method not less than 225 m²/kg
amendments: Amendment No. 1 (2015) - Packaging in HDPE/PP sacks testing
Amendment No. 2 (2019) - Performance cementitious composite ratios

title: Ordinary Portland Cement, 53 Grade - Specification
scope: Covers manufacture, chemical, and physical requirements of 53 grade ordinary Portland cement (OPC 53) intended for high-strength concrete applications, bridges, and pre-stressed concrete works.
description: Standard for high-grade 53 OPC cement offering rapid strength gain, high 28-day strength (> 53 MPa), and high durability in demanding public infrastructure tenders.
technicalRequirements: Compressive strength: 72±1 h ≥ 27 MPa, 168±2 h ≥ 37 MPa, 672±4 h (28 days) ≥ 53 MPa
Fineness by Blaine air permeability method not less than 225 m²/kg
Insoluble residue not more than 4.0% by mass and magnesia (MgO) not more than 6.0%
Total chloride content not more than 0.10% by mass for prestressed and reinforced concrete
amendments: Amendment No. 1 (2015) - Packaging moisture barrier specifications
Amendment No. 2 (2019) - Micro-filler evaluation criteria
